name: ech-mailbox
description: Holds messages other Claude sessions send to this one, so they do not break your flow: they wait in a mailbox, join your next prompt, or arrive as one hourly digest. A message that starts with BLOCKING: still wakes the session at once. Off until you switch it on. Needs function hooks (early access).

enabled.title: Hold peer messages in a mailbox
enabled.description: When on, a message from another session waits in the mailbox unless it starts with BLOCKING:. Waiting messages join your next prompt, or arrive as one digest every hour. When off, the mod does nothing.
